serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I was scared…
You: I know well that if my problems get worse I might end up... {{wi}}you know where.
Blaubleim: …
You: I wasn’t sure what to think about all of this, how much you and mom know. Through the days I had these… {{wi}}negative thoughts in the back of my mind.
Blaubleim: Listen to me very carefully, me and Miss Charlotte don’t want to lock you up in some,{{wi}} some mental asylum! {{wi}}That’s ridiculous!
Blaubleim: I will tell you this young man, there’s nothing to fear when talking to me and so far I didn’t hear anything even close to convincing me that such a drastic step would be necessary.
You: …
